text:
The Ducks captain has been piling up points without much fuss. Mikael Granlund has 26 points in 22 games, 12 on the power play, and Yahoo Sports wrote that he is "on Pace to Reach Triple Digit Point Total." The last ten games alone brought 17 points, where we'd expect about 10 at his ice time.

Some of it is real. He plays 20.6 minutes, runs the top power play, and the chances with him on are up a little on his usual. Evolving-Hockey had him driving play last season (90th percentile among forwards once teammates and opponents are accounted for).

But a lot of it is finishing that tends to fade. He is shooting 19.5%, above the top of our range for him, and Anaheim has scored 8.4 more goals than its chances deserved with him on. At 5v5 the Ducks get only 40.2% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, worse than without him. Our season range is 68 to 93 points, middle 80: a fine year, just short of the hundred the headline hopes for.
